purpose: Execute the atomic apply-constant-fillet operation within the MA-26 boundary: Root-only constant-radius fillet on a supplied current edge set. Variable-radius rounds, component occurrences, edge discovery, and geometry measurement are excluded.
trigger: Use when the build plan requires apply-constant-fillet and all declared inputs have been resolved for the current SpaceClaim V21 action boundary.

inputs.name: body
inputs.description: Current closed nonempty root-part body owning every selected edge.

inputs.name: edges
inputs.description: Nonempty distinct edge references that are members of body.Edges at call time.

inputs.name: radius_mm
inputs.description: One constant fillet radius in millimetres applied to all selected edges.

preconditions: body is a current root DesignBody and passes assert_closed.
edges is nonempty, distinct, and every edge is in the current body's edge collection.

outputs.name: result
outputs.description: {bodies: list<DesignBody>} containing the refreshed current root-part body collection after the mutation.

postconditions: ConstantRound.Execute is called with one radius and result_ok accepts its result.
The action returns a freshly enumerated current root-body collection.

implementation.target_environment: SpaceClaim V21 / IronPython 2.7 action wrapper; runtime execution is evidenced by the attached exact candidate host record; native persistence, visual review, and requested export remain outside this action.
implementation.notes: Execute the atomic apply-constant-fillet operation within the MA-26 boundary: Root-only constant-radius fillet on a supplied current edge set. Variable-radius rounds, component occurrences, edge discovery, and geometry measurement are excluded. Untested variants remain outside the attached exact-run evidence.

ambiguity_checks: Zero or multiple matches must stop the action; numbered aliases and return order are not valid identity criteria.
semantic_selection.topology_refresh: All caller topology caches must be discarded; current_bodies() is re-enumerated after the mutation.

failure_modes.condition: Body/edge identity, distinctness, ownership, or radius validation raises ValueError.
failure_modes.detection: Body/edge identity, distinctness, ownership, or radius validation raises ValueError.
failure_modes.safe_state: Stop downstream use until the declared recovery is completed from a clean state.

failure_modes.condition: ConstantRound reports failure or the post-mutation body collection is unusable.
failure_modes.detection: ConstantRound reports failure or the post-mutation body collection is unusable.
failure_modes.safe_state: Stop downstream use and retain only a clean run-owned state.

recovery.action: Re-enumerate the current body and edges, then retry with a feasible positive radius.
Discard/repair the mutated root model and rerun; the action has no rollback or radius-geometry assertion.
